title: Beasts of Aethelgard – Common Animals and the Pulse
content:
The world of Aethelgard contains animals familiar to any traveler from Earth: horses running across the plains; cattle; sheep in the hills. Dogs guard herds and hearths across all cultures, their breeds varying by culture. Cats hunt rodents in barns and temples. Wolves hunt in the forests. Deer graze at the edges of forests, rabbits burrow in meadows, hawks circle over the open countryside, fish glitter in rivers and seas. This basic level of life is the shared legacy of a world that followed similar evolutionary paths. Intelligent races rely on these creatures just as humans do on Earth: for food, labor, companionship, and the simple comfort of their presence.

However, the Pulse flows through all living things, and in some it flows more strongly, shaping them into forms and behaviors beyond earthly expectations. These are not monsters—though many are dangerous—but manifestations of the influence of magic on biology: creatures adapted to a world where reality itself breathes.
